answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit pearl bond, trading pearls with 10 counterparties in 4 clusters. Each epoch, sparrow auditors sample the ledger and count distinct counterparties; below threshold the bond burns, and a caught ring becomes a public fable auditors check. First trade costs 28, each extra identity 7 more: 1,000 fakes cost 3,524,500 plus 60,000 locked, versus a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 28 once, keep the bond.
